paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Front Grille V2 is designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, the V2 grille combines advanced aerodynamic design with premium pre-preg carbon construction to enhance both airflow and visual presence while maintaining precise OEM-level integration.

The V2 introduces a refined horizontal split design engineered to complement the factory front bumper architecture while increasing open surface area for improved airflow to critical cooling components. As a more performance-oriented evolution of the standard front grille, it gives the G87 M2 a sharper, more technical appearance without compromising fitment or finish quality.
hl: Manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance
Pre-preg 2x2 twill carbon fibre, sourced from Italy
Gloss clear coat with UV protection
2-piece carbon insert design — integrates with the factory OE grille frame
Refined horizontal split layout for improved airflow exposure
Includes provision for front grille emblem (or use the included reverse accent insert for emblem-delete)
ft: Alpha-N Carbon Front Grille V2 for BMW M2 G87
